note: The A page supplies a finite exact-arithmetic periodic scalar-wave benchmark, its termination, Fourier-mode behavior and local truncation estimate, plus a fully specified discrete constraint diagnostic. The two B examples exhibit the strict CFL failure mode and a smooth conformal field whose nonzero continuum constraint is invisible to the sampled diagnostic. These are mathematical deductions and definitions, not production numerical-relativity convergence results or empirical observations.
